news.title: 《战锤40K：行商浪人》最终DLC“亡者行军”将于12月8日发售
news.summary_raw: 《战锤40K：行商浪人》的最终DLC《亡者行军》将于12月8日上线，行商浪人在科罗努斯扩区的壮举也随之迎来终结。与之前所有《行商浪人》DLC一样，《亡者行军》将包括一条新的故事线、同伴、可玩职业、敌人、游戏特色以及更多内容。 如同以往的三个DLC，《亡者行军》将完全整合到游戏本体中，并在整个主线故事里增加新的任务。玩家可以招募圣迹士斯特拉作为同伴，她是一位看似羸弱的年轻女子，由圣科尼亚蒂乌斯修会抚养长大，拥有强大的灵能。在斯特拉的指引下，行商浪人及其随行人员前往亡者行军。这是一个巨大的虚空舰坟场，他们也被困此地。为了逃出生天，他们必须与一支迷失的传教远征队的幸存者合作，深入布满敌舰的坟场深处，查明最初是谁将斯特拉诱骗至此，以及其目的何在。 <内嵌内容，请前往机核查看> 该DLC将包含专注于近战的狂信徒。作为全新的职业，狂信徒擅长用钝器将敌人打击致死。此外，还将加入一个名为“疯狂”的新机制来影响所有同伴，并引入来自混沌大敌和艾达灵族阵营的新敌人，以及更多丰富内容。 《战锤40K：行商浪人》 现可通过 Steam 、 Epic Games Store 及 GOG 在 PC 端购买，主机端则支持 PlayStation 4|5 、 Xbox One 及 Series X|S 以及 Nintendo Switch 2 。

自 6 月抢先体验上线以来，开发商 Nested Loop 的这款收藏布置类游戏已经推出四次大型更新：现代风格、博物馆主题、零售店主题与假日主题更新。每一次更新都带来整套主题家具，以及重磅新功能，包括拍照模式、音乐收纳外壳、视频播放、自定义美术图、物件缩放，还支持通过 Steam 创意工坊分享你的房间作品。
升级至 1.0 版本后，《游戏盒收藏室》将新增海量内容与细节优化。最核心的变化是：依托与 Twitch / IGDB 的全新合作，游戏可以重新在本地拉取你的收藏素材图与元数据。除此之外，本次更新还包含全新引导教程、户外天气系统、升级后的拍照模式、内置 Steam 创意工坊模组浏览界面，还有大家呼声很高的踢脚线 。

news.body:
2026三角洲行动烽火世界杯（DFI 2026）将于11月27日至29日在瑞典斯德哥尔摩DreamHack举行。来自全球六大赛区的12支顶尖战队将齐聚欧洲，争夺50万美元总奖金及年度全球冠军荣誉。
继2025年首届烽火世界杯在杭州举办后，本届赛事首次走出亚洲，登陆国际知名电竞盛会DreamHack。随着国内职业联赛与海外赛区选拔体系逐步完善，来自不同地区的职业战队将在同一舞台展开对决，迎来全球竞技实力的新一轮检验。
随着各赛区选拔赛相继落幕，本届DFI的12支参赛队伍已全部确定。中国大陆赛区由TES、RSG、IBG出征；EMEA赛区由瑞典Alliance (ALL)、英国Fnatic（FNC）代表出战；美洲赛区由美国SSG战队、印度GODL战队晋级。日本赛区冠军FL、韩国赛区冠军NS，以及泛太平洋赛区的中国台湾RX战队、泰国MKK战队、印尼ONIC战队，也将齐聚瑞典斯德哥尔摩，共赴这场全球烽火对决。
与上一届相比，本届世界杯的全球选拔体系进一步完善。中国大陆赛区通过职业联赛成绩与年度积分确定出征名单；美洲、EMEA、韩国赛区依托三角洲行动官方的跨区域赛事体系2026 Delta Force Rise Series，通过体系化的积分与晋级制度选拔；日本及泛太平洋赛区则通过地区赛事2026 Delta Force: Invitational Japan Qualifier 和 Pan-Pacific Operations Cup S2层层选拔，争夺晋级资格。
六大赛区的共同参与，意味着《三角洲行动》正在从区域性职业竞技走向更加系统化的全球赛事竞争，也让不同地区对“搜、打、撤”玩法的战术理解有机会在同一赛场接受检验。
中国大陆赛区由TES、RSG、IBG三支队伍出战。其中，TES是2026年烽火职业联赛春、夏双冠得主，凭借贯穿全年的稳定发挥锁定世界杯参赛资格。队内选手white更连续斩获春、夏季赛总决赛FMVP，成为本届中国赛区值得关注的核心选手之一。
二号种子RSG在整个夏季赛中不断调整，从更依赖个人能力的打法，逐步建立起更完整的团队协作。三名选手的赛季击败数均超过125次，队伍的首砖率也位列联赛第一；队伍随后率先锁定总决赛席位，并最终以亚军身份晋级世界赛。
第三号种子IBG凭借春夏季赛的稳定表现晋级。相比纯粹的正面交火，IBG更擅长对比赛信息的阅读、转点时机掌控以及对对手落点的预判。这三支队伍风格各异，带着不同赛区的实战经验，将迎接来自全球强队的检验。
海外赛区的争夺同样漫长且激烈。自今年7月起，2026 RISE SERIES S1便拉开帷幕，美洲与EMEA赛区的队伍历经两个赛季的持续拉锯。最终，瑞典老牌俱乐部Alliance (ALL)、重返世界赛的Fnatic (FNC) 拿下EMEA前两号种子；美洲赛区则由完成阵容升级的SSG与从公开预选赛一路杀出的全巴西阵容GODL夺得冠亚军，成功突围。
在亚太赛区，选拔机制呈现出多元且严苛的特点。韩国赛区于今年9月才正式宣布加入RISE SERIES体系，在极短的时间内，各支队伍在10月的RISE SERIES KOREA中展开激战，最终由建队仅数月、由名教头DEADDOG带队的Nongshim RedForce (NS) 斩获唯一名额。日本赛区除全年四届的日常联赛（DELTA FORCE OPEN SERIES）外，还专门设立了针对本次世界杯的独立预选赛，综合电竞豪门FENNEL (FL) 脱颖而出。泛太平洋赛区则采用了“地区赛+总决赛”的双层漏斗机制，覆盖中国台湾、印尼、越南、泰国、新马菲等多个国家和地区。各区域先决出种子队伍，再统一进行泛太平洋杯（Pan-Pacific Operations Cup S2）的残酷厮杀，最终中国台湾RX、泰国MKK与印尼ONIC三支新锐力量以前三名的身份拿到了通往斯德哥尔摩的机票。
本届烽火世界杯不仅是《三角洲行动》首个在亚洲以外举办的搜打撤国际赛事，更标志着该赛事成为了首个通过完整职业联赛体系选拔出征、并作为正式比赛项目落地瑞典DreamHack嘉年华的中国自研电竞赛事。
作为国际知名电竞盛会，DreamHack曾承载2011年《英雄联盟》首届全球总决赛及2013年首届CS Major。值得一提的是，Fnatic俱乐部旗下不同电竞项目的队伍曾分别在上述两届赛事中夺冠。如今，Fnatic将以《三角洲行动》参赛队伍的身份再次登上DreamHack舞台，为本届赛事增添了跨越不同电竞时代的历史连接。
从2025年杭州举办首届烽火世界杯，到2026年全球六大赛区通过各自赛事体系选拔队伍、共同会师瑞典，《三角洲行动》正逐步建立起覆盖不同市场的职业竞技体系。
不同于传统FPS赛事主要围绕交战胜负展开，《三角洲行动》烽火赛事将信息获取、战术交火、资源运营与撤离决策融入同一竞技过程，对队伍的综合判断与临场应变提出了新的要求。随着来自不同地区的知名职业战队不断加入，伴随着职业联赛赛制不断推陈出新，加上本届烽火世界杯严苛的选拔体系，种种动作表明这一新兴电竞品类的全球竞技生态也在持续发展。
11月27日至29日，全球六大赛区的12支顶尖战队将在瑞典斯德哥尔摩展开最终角逐。究竟是中国赛区延续强势，还是海外战队实现突破，2026三角洲行动烽火世界杯即将揭晓答案。

news.title: Report: Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor lays off an unspecified number of staff
news.summary_raw: A few months after the game's release, it looked like maybe Bit Reactor was putting itself back together, but a new report indicates that the Star Wars tactical title's developer is suffering layoffs.

members.title: Report: Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor lays off an unspecified number of staff
Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor has laid off an unspecified number of people

news.body:
Report: Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor lays off an unspecified number of staff
A few months after the game's release, it looked like maybe Bit Reactor was putting itself back together, but a new report indicates that the Star Wars tactical title's developer is suffering layoffs.
Just a few months after Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor let the majority of staff go ahead of the game's launch and a few weeks after it rehired some of the furloughed workers, it seems that Bit Reactor has moved toward laying off an unspecified number of people from the company.
Citing LinkedIn posts from developers who posted their personal news on the job-searching social media platform, Star Wars news site Bespin Bulletin, which spotted these initial posts, points out that these layoffs seem to be the end result of the August furlough and were potentially some of the employees at the end of the three-month furlough process being let go. There is no evidence at present that anyone brought back from the furlough in October were let go, as Bespin Bulletin clarifies.
Bit Reactor was founded in 2022 by former Fireraxis art director Greg Foertsch and leveraged talent from Firaxis' own XCOM series for the development of Zero Company. While public sales data for the game has not been released, and may not be given that publisher Electronic Arts has been taken private, analysis firm Alinea Analytics estimates the game to have sold around one million copies by late September.
After bringing back some of the furloughed workers, Zero Company has received a 1.2 update, but there has been little word about the future of the game since.
GameDeveloper.com has reached out to Bit Reactor for comment, but has not received a reply by time of publication.

news.summary_raw: KRAFTON公布2026年第三季度及前三季度财务业绩，营收、营业利润创历史同期新高，同时披露PUBG IP运营、新IP布局、AI研发、股东回报等进展。

members.title: KRAFTON公布2026年第三季度业绩 实现营收9714亿韩元

news.body:
KRAFTON今日公布了2026年第三季度财务业绩。根据韩国采用的国际财务报告准则（K-IFRS）编制的合并财务报表，KRAFTON第三季度实现营收9714亿韩元，营业利润2250亿韩元。2026年前三季度累计营收达3.6330万亿韩元，累计营业利润达1.1975万亿韩元，同比分别增长51%和14%，两项指标均创历史同期新高。前三季度累计营业利润已达到2025年全年营业利润的114%。
2026年第三季度主要业绩
第三季度各业务收入情况如下：
PC业务： 2389亿韩元（同比下降32.5%）
移动业务： 5043亿韩元（同比上升3.2%）
主机业务： 86亿韩元（同比下降15.9%）
其他业务： 2196亿韩元（同比上升1117.8%）
PUBG IP持续保持稳健增长，前三季度累计收入同比增长11%。《PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS》在PC及主机平台的月活跃用户数保持两位数增长。
移动业务方面，受暑期旺季与《火影忍者》及法拉利等全球知名IP联动活动的推动，收入同比增长3%，环比增长12%。其他业务收入中，包含ADK Group贡献的1984亿韩元广告及内容业务收入。第三季度营业利润为2250亿韩元，反映出公司参与科隆国际游戏展及开展其他活动所产生的相关费用。
PUBG IP：通过UGC与IP联动拓展游戏体验
PUBG IP正持续向提供多元化游戏体验的平台发展，其目标是成为跨越地区与世代、引发全球玩家共鸣的文化符号。继2025年12月在PC平台引入用户生成内容（UGC）后，KRAFTON于今年8月推出“PUBG: Playgrounds”，让玩家能够发现并体验丰富的社区创作内容。移动端方面，KRAFTON进一步扩展了“World of Wonder（WOW）”中的全球IP联动内容，并引入UGC商业化机制，持续扩大UGC生态。这些举措为玩家提供了更多参与PUBG IP内容的方式，也进一步增强了玩家持续回归游戏的动力。
第四季度，KRAFTON将通过丰富游戏玩法、扩大移动业务在新兴市场的覆盖范围，以及强化PUBG品牌影响力，进一步拓展玩家群体。自11月起，公司已与韩国女团IVE展开联动，推出涵盖游戏内外的多种体验活动。面向新兴市场推出的轻量化版本“BGMI Air”计划于12月10日上线，目前预约人数已突破1400万人。此外，KRAFTON还在筹备2027年PUBG十周年纪念内容更新，规模将创下历年之最。
新IP布局：《Subnautica 2：异星水域》持续增长与《PUBG: DED.NET》市场验证
《Subnautica 2：异星水域》全球累计销量已突破500万份，目前Steam平台好评率保持在91%。此外，游戏目前的愿望单数量达到445万，反映出潜在玩家对作品的持续关注。KRAFTON将重点推进游戏正式版上线的准备工作，并计划于今年年底推出抢先体验2.0大型更新，进一步提升产品品质。同时，公司也将探索在游戏内外拓展该IP的更多可能性。
《PUBG: DED.NET》是KRAFTON于今年8月科隆国际游戏展首次公开的PUBG IP新作，主要面向欧美市场的主机射击游戏玩家。游戏将《PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS》的射击体验与Roguelite成长机制相结合，打造差异化的游戏体验。今年10月举行的封闭测试验证了该作品的市场潜力。KRAFTON将根据测试参与者的反馈持续完善游戏玩法，为2027年正式推出做好准备。
AI：通过Raon-1 mini Preview强化自主研发能力
KRAFTON于10月21日公开了自主研发的大语言模型（LLM）“Raon-1 mini Preview”。该模型在韩语处理能力、响应速度及推理效率等方面，展现出韩国同级别模型中的顶尖性能。
KRAFTON计划利用这一针对游戏语言及机制进行训练的自研模型，进一步强化包括“PUBG Ally”在内的游戏AI技术能力。未来，公司还计划推出更大规模的“Raon-1”模型及全双工语音模型，将游戏领域积累的AI技术经验拓展至未来业务领域专用模型的研发。
股东回报
根据今年2月公布的股东回报政策，截至第三季度，KRAFTON已累计回购约4000亿韩元库存股，并完成996亿韩元的减资分红。公司将今年新回购的库存股与此前持有的1177亿韩元库存股合并计算，累计注销库存股金额达5176亿韩元，相当于公司已发行股份总数的4.4%。
KRAFTON认为，当前股价尚未充分反映公司的实际价值，因此董事会于11月3日决定额外回购3000亿韩元库存股，并将所回购股份全部注销。计入本次追加回购及注销计划后，2026年股东回报总规模预计将达到9172亿韩元，创下公司自2023年实施股东回报计划以来的年度最高纪录。未来，KRAFTON将综合考虑经营业绩、市场环境及财务能力，持续推进提升股东价值的相关举措。

news.title: ArtStation Adds AI Declarations & Default AI Filtering for Artwork
news.summary_raw: Artists can now label how much generative AI was used in a project and report work they suspect is unlabeled, while users can choose how much AI content they see.

members.title: ArtStation Adds AI Declarations & Default AI Filtering for Artwork

news.body:
ArtStation Adds AI Declarations & Default AI Filtering for Artwork
Artists can now label how much generative AI was used in a project and report work they suspect is unlabeled, while users can choose how much AI content they see.
In case you missed it
First phase of ArtStation's AI content controls
ArtStation
ArtStation, the showcase platform for artists, has introduced the next phase of its generative AI content controls. Creators now face clearer AI declaration requirements, and the AI filter is enabled by default with adjustable settings.
When publishing a project, creators will now be asked to declare whether generative AI was used in making it. There are several options that identify a work by how much of it was made with AI:
- Primarily generative AI
- Mixed generative AI and non-generative methods
- 100% non-generative
This gives users more context about the creative process behind the work they browse.
ArtStation
Artists can also now report work they suspect was made with AI but wasn't labeled:
ArtStation
When browsing, users can choose whether to hide declared generative AI content, allow mixed generative and non-generative workflows, and adjust how strongly the platform's filters act on user reports of suspected generative AI projects. The strict filter hides the most content and filters artwork when a few signals suggest it may be AI-generated. The balanced setting filters artwork when there is a moderate level of reports, while the loose filter does so only when user signals are strongest.
By default, the updated filter will hide any project declared as AI-generated, tagged with "CreatedwithAI," or tagged with generative AI tools, and the filter for suspected AI content will be set to strict.
ArtStation
Previously, ArtStation introduced measures to protect artists' work from unauthorized AI training. The platform's existing NoAI setting, which communicates that an artist's work cannot be used to train an AI system, will now be enabled by default for every new project, and the company is also applying the tag retroactively to existing projects and profiles.
In August, ArtStation and Sketchfab were acquired by KitBash from Epic Games.

members.title: Making an Ethereal, Moonlight-Inspired Fantasy Character in 3D

news.body:
Making an Ethereal, Moonlight-Inspired Fantasy Character in 3D
Alex Borkovskiy talks about developing the concept behind his cinematic personal project, Galatea, explains how he handled intricate texturing on the character's clothing and shoes, and comments on the lighting setup that helped him keep the textures stylized without looking plasticky.
Introduction
My name is Alex Borkovskiy, and I'm a 3D Character Artist. My path into the profession was quite unconventional. I studied child psychology, later worked in the fashion industry, and then studied at the Moscow Film School.
Like many of us, I became interested in 3D during the COVID-19 pandemic and started teaching myself character creation. Quite unexpectedly, I found that my previous experience came together very naturally in character art – through my interest in people, their personalities and inner states, visual identity, and storytelling.
I'm self-taught: I studied the work of other artists, followed tutorials, and spent a lot of time learning anatomy and character design. But practice and personal projects have always been the most important part of my learning process.
About a year and a half later, I got my first job in the game industry and joined Toadman Interactive as a 3D Character Artist, where I worked for around two years. I currently work as a 3D Character Artist at Long Leap Games.
Working in game development gave me experience with the full production pipeline and an understanding of the technical requirements for game characters. At the same time, personal projects give me more freedom to explore design, visual storytelling, and cinematic presentation. Galatea became a project where I could bring these two sides of my work together.
Getting Started with Galatea
When I work on my own characters, I usually begin with small sketches in a notebook. With Galatea, however, I wanted to create a more ambitious project, so for the first time I decided to develop a full 2D concept in Photoshop.
I knew I wanted to create a fantasy character connected to the moon and magic. Early on, I defined several key associations: moonlight, darkness, magic, air, water, and transparency. I wanted Galatea to feel light and slightly ethereal, as if something in her were moonlight reflected on water. The circle became the foundation of her shape language, referencing the moon. This motif then appeared throughout the design – in her facial features, hairstyle, jewelry, and the crescent shape of her staff.
Romanticism and Gothic aesthetics are an important part of my visual language, and I wanted to express them not through literal historical stylization, but through mood, silhouette, and materials. The work of Alexander McQueen was one of the main influences on the costume. I've always been drawn to the house's combination of romanticism and Gothic elements, as well as its complex silhouettes and theatricality.
In the end, the 2D concept became a kind of map for the entire project. Before moving fully into 3D, I already had a clear understanding of the main shapes, palette, hairstyle, costume, jewelry, and the overall visual language of the character.
Sculpting
For the face and body, I used my own base meshes and then reworked them in ZBrush. I wanted to slightly move away from fully realistic proportions while keeping a believable anatomical foundation. I made the face rounder, with broad, prominent cheekbones, large eyes, and a small mouth, which also supported the key circular shape of the character.
I created the basic construction of the dress in Marvelous Designer, using it mainly as a blockout. I then brought it into ZBrush and manually refined the shapes, folds, and details to bring it closer to the original concept.
The hairstyle was one of the design's most important elements. At first glance, I wanted it to feel relatively simple and youthful, while the actual construction was much more elaborate and ceremonial. The large side buns continued the circular motif, while loose strands and flyaways broke up the hairstyle's perfection and made it feel more alive.
I first sculpted the main hair masses in ZBrush to test the volume and silhouette. For the final version, I used hair cards, but adapted the usual workflow to something that felt more natural to me. I prepared a set of cards with textures and transparency, brought them into ZBrush as a kind of palette, and assembled the final hairstyle directly around the character's head. I'm much more comfortable working with organic forms in ZBrush, so this approach felt very intuitive.
I also created most of the jewelry and the staff in ZBrush, occasionally using ZModeler for hard-surface elements. The jewelry gradually became more elaborate and decorative until it had the sense of richness and almost ceremonial quality I was looking for.
One of the main ways I avoided unnecessary work was by developing the 2D concept in detail beforehand. I also reused several repeating elements, such as braids, cords, and parts of the jewelry, and, whenever possible, created smaller accessories with relatively simple geometry from the beginning.
Retopology
I did most of the retopology for Galatea in TopoGun and made additional adjustments to the low-poly model in Blender when necessary. Even during the modeling stage, I tried to consider which elements genuinely required dedicated retopology and which could remain relatively lightweight. Small details that didn't affect the silhouette were transferred into the bake or textures whenever possible.
I created the UVs in Blender. I didn't use a UDIM workflow; instead, I divided the character into several texture sets based on materials and surface types. Some visually complex elements also remained geometrically simple. For example, the lace inserts on the dress were created using opacity/alpha textures.
Since Galatea was a personal cinematic project, I wasn't working within a specific polygon budget. My goal was to find a reasonable balance: optimize the geometry where it wouldn't affect the result, while preserving enough density for the silhouette, design, and close-up presentation.
Texturing
I baked the main maps in Marmoset Toolbag and did the texturing in Substance 3D Painter. I had a simple PolyPaint on the face in ZBrush, but it was only used as a visual aid during sculpting; the final skin textures were created in Substance 3D Painter.
I created the skin microdetail, including pores, on the high-poly model in ZBrush using alphas. In Substance 3D Painter, I then focused on color, tonal variation, and roughness, while keeping in mind how the skin would later interact with SSS in Arnold. I added warmer and slightly redder tones in areas where the skin is thinner.
The clothing was one of the more time-consuming parts of the texturing process, especially the boots. For the patterns on the dress and boots, I used tileable alpha patterns as a base and adapted them in Substance 3D Painter.
I used Height to give the ornament actual surface relief rather than leaving it as a flat graphic, while variations in roughness helped separate the different materials. With the boots in particular, I had to combine several surfaces, ornamental patterns, and lacing while keeping the fairly complex design readable.
With the very light lilac hair, it was important to avoid a plastic appearance. Roughness played an important role here, together with the final material setup in Arnold. I also used a small amount of Subsurface Scattering to make the hair respond more softly to the light.
For the eyes, I allowed myself to move slightly further away from realism. During shading, I used a mask to introduce a very subtle emissive component. I didn't want the eyes to literally glow – the intention was simply to suggest a faint sense of light coming from within.
For the metallic accessories, I used a fairly standard PBR approach. The main challenge was finding the right tone for the gold. I didn't want it to become too saturated or yellow and start competing with Galatea's cool white-and-lilac palette.
Overall, the main challenge was making a large number of different materials – skin, hair, fabrics, metal, and decorative surfaces – feel distinct while still looking like they belong to the same character.
Lighting & Rendering
I did the final lighting and rendering in Maya with Arnold. The lighting setup was based on an HDRI and a main key light, followed by several additional lights that gave me more precise control over the character's forms, materials, and individual details.
For example, I kept the purple gemstones fairly stylized rather than building a complex physically accurate gemstone shader. Since their faceting was relatively simple, I used additional lights to help them catch the light and remain visible among the other jewelry pieces.
The ears' translucency came from a combination of relatively thin geometry, an SSS material, and lighting. This allowed the light to pass softly through the thinner areas of the skin and create the characteristic warm effect.
I did the final post-processing in Photoshop, making subtle adjustments to contrast and tonal balance. I also used Photoshop to assemble the collages and breakdown pages for the final presentation.
Conclusion
The main challenge for me was the overall scale of Galatea. I started the character from my own sketches and concept and took her through the entire production cycle to the final presentation. At the same time, I created the whole project alongside my full-time job, so it taught me a lot about discipline and managing a large personal project over a long period of time.
Galatea was also my first personal ArtStation project where I worked entirely with hair cards. news.title: 连黑洞都能拿来脱毛？《脱毛沙龙模拟器》发售
news.summary_raw: 《脱毛沙龙模拟器》已在Steam发售，玩家经营男性脱毛沙龙，需把控脱毛操作，另有黑洞、喷火器等离谱工具与狂热模式，可经营扩建店铺，首发9折后26.1元。

members.title: 连黑洞都能拿来脱毛？《脱毛沙龙模拟器》发售

news.body:
把黑洞搬进脱毛室，用喷火器给客人除毛，甚至把治疗室改造成迪厅……魔性模拟经营游戏《脱毛沙龙模拟器》，显然没打算让玩家正经脱毛！
Steam商店页：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4351380/
在游戏中，玩家将经营一家专为男性顾客服务的脱毛沙龙，每天拿起剃须刀和激光仪，帮一位位毛发旺盛的猛男打理体毛。别看操作只是拿鼠标扫一扫，真想把这活儿干好，还得有点技术。激光照射太久，顾客的疼痛槽就会飙升，轻则惨叫连连，严重时甚至会投诉。想把毛发清理干净，又不把客人疼跑，就得掌握好照射时机，必要时还得用上麻醉霜和冷却凝胶。
不过，老老实实脱毛只是个开始。随着进度槽蓄满，狂热模式便会启动。音乐响起，迪斯科球开始旋转，原本普通的脱毛过程瞬间变成了一场热闹的脱毛派对。游戏还准备了不少离谱的脱毛工具，除了常规的激光和剃须刀，胶带、喷火器，甚至黑洞、山羊都能派上用场。前一秒还在小心翼翼地控制激光，后一秒就用黑洞对付客人的体毛，至于脱毛为什么需要这些东西，恐怕只有开发者自己知道了。
说起来，这款游戏的灵感居然真的来源于开发者的一次脱毛经历。他曾向日本文字益智游戏《词汇谜题》的制作人请教，对方建议他从日常生活中寻找创作灵感。巧的是，第二天他正好预约了脱毛，于是便有了制作这款游戏的想法。游戏里的激光设备、治疗室氛围和疼痛感，都参考了他的亲身体验。为了让游戏不只是搞笑，开发者还特意打磨了操作手感与音效，并邀请100多名玩家参与试玩，希望玩家既能被各种离谱场面逗乐，也能享受到清理毛发的爽快感。
当然，开店终究是要赚钱的。客人脱完毛，还可以根据他们的钱包厚度推荐护理产品。预算有限的安排平价护理，出手大方的则可以推荐VIP套餐。不过，服务做得好不好，都会反映在点评网站上。好评能吸引更多客人，差评多了，生意也会受到影响。等赚够了钱，玩家还能升级设备、装修扩建、招募员工，让这家画风清奇的脱毛店越开越大。
由Yoshio Games开发、2P Games发行的《脱毛沙龙模拟器》现已在Steam正式发售，售价29元，首发7天限时9折，折后仅需26.1元。设备就位，猛男躺好，小店能不能做大，就看你的手艺了。

members.title: Steam新品节玩家数第一！《我带过的最差一届》正式发售

news.body:
10月刚在Steam新品节和大家见过面的《我带过的最差一届》，这次终于迎来了正式版！售价为28元，首发14天限时享受35%折扣，折后仅需18.20元。游戏还和《BOMBANANA!》组了个捆绑包「我吃过的最差香蕉」，打包购买享9折！先叫上朋友来教室里斗智斗勇，下课了再找两个搭档，一起挑战拆弹任务。
Steam商店页面：https://store.steampowered.com/app/5175310
游戏的免费Demo在新品节期间登上Steam玩家数榜第一，累计下载量突破100万次。如今正式版也带来了不少新东西，除了更多教室、角色和道具，还加入了房间自定义、局域网联机等功能。当年课上没干的，这次全补上！
游戏最多支持8人联机，1名玩家扮演老师，其余7人扮演学生。学生需要混在几十名NPC同学中，趁老师不注意完成各种恶作剧。偷吃零食、传纸条、玩手机，都得看准时机，稍有不慎就会被老师当场抓包。老师则要在人群中寻找真正的玩家，看看是谁敢在你的课堂上捣蛋，必要时还能用粉笔头精准点名。学生在老师眼皮底下搞小动作，老师找到破绽揪出害群之马，师生之间的课堂智斗每局都有名场面。
正式版这次还准备了不少新内容。全新的女班主任登场，造型看着有几分眼熟，抓起人来可不含糊。游戏还新增了10种主题教室，从寝室、火锅教室、厕所到操场，每个场景都有不同的整活空间。烟雾弹、无人机、隐身喷雾等更多趣味道具也加入其中，让整蛊与对抗玩法无限升级。
想玩点不一样的，还可以在房间里调整20多项参数，是一群学生各显神通，还是一圈老师“专家会诊”，下节课的规矩由你定。正式版的单局人数上限也提升至8人，同时加入了局域网联机和Steam创意工坊，并优化了服务器，让对局体验更流畅。拉上朋友开黑调参数立规矩，或者进入别人的教室当个插班生，都能折腾出不少新玩法。
由顽核社制作、2P Games与Elegoose Games联合发行的《我带过的最差一届》现已正式登陆Steam！叫上朋友一起开课，看看这回谁能在教室里笑到最后！

news.title: "There's no such thing as easy money in our business" – Strauss Zelnick on GTA 6, BioShock, Take-Two's acquisition plans, and reviving old IP
news.summary_raw: Take-Two Interactive reported the earnings for its second quarter today, and GamesIndustry.biz had a chance to talk with CEO Strauss Zelnick about the results, as well as where the company is headed.

members.title: "There's no such thing as easy money in our business" – Strauss Zelnick on GTA 6, BioShock, Take-Two's acquisition plans, and reviving old IP

news.body:
"There's no such thing as easy money in our business" – Strauss Zelnick on GTA 6, BioShock, Take-Two's acquisition plans, and reviving old IP
"We are working on some legacy franchises that we're excited about"
Take-Two Interactive reported the earnings for its second quarter today, and GamesIndustry.biz had a chance to talk with CEO Strauss Zelnick about the results, as well as where the company is headed.
Naturally, all eyes are on Grand Theft Auto 6 right now, the launch of which next week could be not only the biggest game launch of all time, but the biggest entertainment product launch of all time in terms of revenue. Pre-orders are currently at nearly 8 million, according to Sensor Tower.
But what are Take-Two's goals beyond GTA? What's happening with BioShock 4, which was announced back in 2019, but seems to have hit a stumbling block, with redundancies announced last year at developer Cloud Chamber? What about the live-service extraction shooter Project Ethos, which was first announced in 2024? What about new IP and reviving old franchises? And where does the firm see growth coming from in the future?
Here's what Zelnick had to say.
What are the things you're most excited about in this report?
We had a terrific quarter, obviously. We were at the low end of our net bookings range, but obviously in terms of profitability performance, we were very, very strong. We have an array of great releases. NBA 2K27 is the second most successful launch in the history of the NBA 2K franchise, and our pre-orders for GTA 6 outperformed our expectations. So we're feeling exceedingly positive for the rest of the year.
You said pre-orders outperformed your expectations. What were your expectations?
[We cannot] disclose the numbers, but the point that we're making is our prior expectations obviously were aligned with our guidance, and the pre-orders are far exceeding our original expectations. We're maintaining our guidance, because the release is only 10 days away and we'll know a lot more after the release.
Well, that was going to be my next question, because I noticed you kept your guidance at $8 billion for the year, so I'm presuming that you're not predicting a bigger than expected launch.
We're just not updating our numbers right now because we are so close to the launch. However, pre-orders are far exceeding our expectations.
I wanted to ask about a couple of other things mentioned in the report. I saw Bioshock is still in there. Can you give me an update on what's going on with that game?
It's still in development. We feel very good about how it's going.
It sounds like it's been through the ringer, though. There was a report in 2025 that there were around 80 redundancies and a change in leadership. Does that mean the game has been reset?
We definitely did face some development challenges. We feel like we're on the right track now, but you're correct, we did face some challenges along the way.
And what about Project Ethos? Again, that has been in development for a very long time. Will we be able to see that soon?
We did a public beta that was disappointing, and we made a bunch of changes. We think they've been very beneficial and feel exceedingly optimistic right now.
Well, I was going to ask, do you feel like the live service wave has passed now? I mean, we've already had quite a few high profile live service failures down the years. Do you think maybe the time for this game has passed?
We do not, although we've said all along that free-to-play titles are very challenging, whether that's in mobile or PC or console. But live service, I would say that's too broad a brush, because live services are extremely successful. The bulk of our business is represented by live services and what we call recurrent consumer spend. It's the vast majority of our business today.
Yes, I noticed that something like 81% of your net bookings come from recurrent consumer spending. Basically, your business runs on monetisation.
The business basically runs on live services, punctuated by, we hope, some huge releases.
I also wanted to pick up on something at the end of the report. You mentioned you're pursuing accretive mergers and acquisitions (M&A). I just wanted to ask what that means and what kind of companies you're planning to target.
Within interactive entertainment, we're always looking for accretive transactions that add new intellectual property, new technology, new talent, and new audiences to our company. The most recent large acquisition was Zynga, which has been accretive. And then more recently Gearbox, also an accretive deal for us. Accretive simply means that our EPS [earnings per share] goes up as opposed to down when we do the deal.
So the Zynga deal was a positive from the start?
It had its moments. We closed the deal in mid '22, and then the mobile business basically fell out of bed immediately thereafter. So undoubtedly we had major challenges in the company. Those have been addressed, but the deal was accretive from the get-go.
I'm interested in which areas you're targeting for M&A. Is there any particular area that you're looking at?
We haven't specifically said what particular companies we pursue. We generally don't talk about that. We simply announce deals when we've done them. But we're interested in all areas of interactive entertainment to the extent that they make sense for us.
You also mentioned in the report that you're anticipating growth. I'm wondering, aside from Grand Theft Auto 6, which obviously is going to be a big earner for you this year, where is that growth going to come from?
Really across the board. We have numerous hit franchises. In fact, a total of 15 that have each sold at least five million units in an individual release, plus an enormous, powerful, successful mobile business that was up 4% year over year in the quarter, and continues to perform, and is launching new hits all the time. So as a broad-based powerful business with what we believe is the best collection of owned intellectual property in the interactive entertainment business, there's plenty of opportunity for growth and success across the board.
Of course, but I would say that a lot of that strategy involves seasoned titles, releasing yearly updates. Are there any areas where you're looking for new games or new IP?
We're always looking for new IP. We selectively invest in new IP. New IP is the riskiest part of our business, but we only have the company we have today because we've been willing to invest in new IP over the years.
You mentioned you've got a huge range of IP. I wonder whether you plan to revive some of the older IP that 2K has accrued over the years? You've got so many studios under your belt and so many franchises.
We are working on some legacy franchises that we're excited about. And you're right, we own a bunch of IP that we have not exploited in recent years, and it's always possible that we will. It's on our to-do list.
It does seem to be a trend. I know EA re-released Wing Commander the other day. I guess it's easy money, isn't it? It's there on the table for you to take it.
There's no such thing as easy money in our business.

members.title: Take-Two Q2 net bookings fall 18% to $1.6bn as NBA 2K27 misses forecast but GTA 6 pre-orders are "tracking far in excess" of expectations

news.body:
Take-Two Q2 net bookings fall 18% to $1.6bn as NBA 2K27 misses forecast but GTA 6 pre-orders are "tracking far in excess" of expectations
Publisher reiterates full-year net bookings outlook of $8 billion to $8.2 billion ahead of GTA 6's launch next week
Take-Two Interactive has published its financial results for its second fiscal quarter, with net bookings down 18% to $1.60 billion and net revenue down 16% to $1.50 billion.
Net bookings came in slightly below the $1.62 billion to $1.67 billion the publisher had advised. Take-Two said NBA 2K27 had the second-highest net bookings launch in the series' history, but still fell short of its forecast for the period.
The company has kept its full-year net bookings outlook at $8 billion to $8.2 billion, with Grand Theft Auto 6 due to launch on November 19.
Here's what you need to know:
The numbers
- Net revenue: $1.50 billion (down 16% year-on-year)
- Net loss: $54 million (compared to $133.9 million loss in the year-ago quarter)
- Total net bookings: $1.60 billion (down 18% year-on-year)
The highlights
NBA 2K27 has sold over 4 million units since its September 4 launch. Take-Two said the launch window was "unusually busy," and expects net bookings and engagement to pick up in the second half of the fiscal year as more post-launch content arrives.
The Grand Theft Auto series beat the publisher's forecast for the quarter. Grand Theft Auto 5 has now sold nearly 235 million units, and both recurrent consumer spending and average monthly GTA+ members grew by a double-digit percentage.
Take-Two said pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 are "tracking far in excess of our initial expectations." The company expects operating expenses to rise by around 21% year-on-year in the third quarter on a management basis, primarily due to marketing for the game.
The Borderlands franchise has passed 100 million units sold.
Mobile performed in line with Take-Two's plans. Net bookings for Color Block Jam fell by double digits against a peak in the same quarter last year, while Toon Blast grew 4% and Words With Friends grew 6%, helped by a collaboration with Wheel of Fortune. NBA 2K All-Star, released in China with Tencent, has passed 11 million registered users.
"The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company," said Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick.
Looking ahead, Take-Two expects third-quarter net bookings of $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion, compared to $1.76 billion in the same quarter last year. It has also raised its full-year GAAP net revenue guidance to between $7.98 billion and $8.18 billion (it was previously between $7.9 billion and $8.1 billion).
In August, Take-Two Interactive subpoenaed Microsoft, Discord, and X regarding the ongoing Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks.

news.what: Take-Two公布第二财季业绩：净预订额同比下降18%至16亿美元，净收入下降16%至15亿美元，略低于此前指引；NBA 2K27销量超400万份但未达预期；公司维持全年净预订额80亿至82亿美元展望，GTA 6定于11月19日发售。

members.title: Tripwire Interactive lays off 36

news.body:
Tripwire Interactive lays off 36
The cuts are the studio's second round of layoffs this year
Killing Floor and Maneater developer Tripwire Interactive has laid off 36 staff.
In a statement posted to Twitter/X today, the studio said: "Today we share difficult news: Tripwire has undergone a workforce reduction, affecting 36 talented people across our studio. This was certainly not an easy decision, but unfortunately a necessary one for the organization."
Tripwire said its remaining staff are focused on internal projects, including "active development of Maneater 2, ongoing work on Killing Floor 3 and publishing efforts under the Tripwire Presents label," adding that it would support those affected "with compassion and dignity during this transition."
The layoffs come just days after Tripwire expanded its publishing business to support smaller self-published indie developers. It's the second round of layoffs this year, after 23 staff were laid off in March.
Tripwire was founded in 2005 by John Gibson and Alan Wilson. Gibson stepped down as CEO in 2021 following anti-abortion comments, with Wilson taking on the role of interim CEO.
In 2022, the developer was acquired by the Embracer Group via its former subsidiary Saber Interactive. Former CFO Matthew LoPilato was promoted to CEO in 2024.
Embracer sold Saber Interactive for $247 million in 2024 but kept Tripwire.
news.title_cn: Tripwire Interactive裁员36人，为今年第二轮
news.what: 《杀戮空间》《食人鲨》开发商Tripwire Interactive宣布裁员36人，称这是组织必要的艰难决定。剩余员工将继续开发《食人鲨2》《杀戮空间3》及Tripwire Presents发行业务。这是该公司今年第二轮裁员，3月已裁23人。

members.title: World of Warcraft: Forever is the MMORPG's biggest launch as measured by peak concurrent players

news.body:
schedule1 Min Read
via Blizzard Entertainment
Newsbrief: World of Warcraft developer Blizzard Entertainment has reported on social media that the launch of World of Warcraft: Forever, an alternate version of the company's blockbuster MMORPG, has broken records for the game's various update and expansion launches.
The launch achieved the biggest launch by peak concurrent players and the highest number of returning players in the game's history. Forever goes back to the first year of the MMORPG and rebuilds new content from its foundations with things like new character races, a plan that the World of Warcraft player base seemingly finds appealing.

members.title: 橙光游戏平台：困在浪潮起落间

news.body:
新的浪潮正在奔流。
几乎每天，你都能看到B站UP主逍遥散人的《逆袭之星途闪耀》视频下方在刷新新的弹幕和玩家留言。这是一条发布于2014年的直播回放，截至目前，这条视频的播放量已经接近4000万，并被收录进入B站入站必刷98大视频。
《逆袭之星途闪耀》是2014年最火爆的橙光游戏之一，它讲述了女主在进入娱乐圈后经历一系列起伏，最终成长为超级巨星的故事。这是一款典型的橙光游戏，采用立绘结合大量剧情文本而制作，分支设计夸张惊险。凭借着玛丽苏剧情和逍遥散人的直播效果，《逆袭之星途闪耀》热度一路走高，人气值超1000万，登顶当年橙光人气榜。橙光游戏也因此进入大众视野。
同样是2014年，橙光开始受到资本市场的关注，当年获得50万美元的天使轮融资。2015年，橙光获得300万美元的融资，同年鲜花商城上线，橙光正式开启付费之旅。
2016年，橙光获得1000万元融资，《逆袭之星途闪耀》《绝世千金》等作品卖出电视剧版权。两年后，橙光获得的融资达到1亿元——同一时间内，数家与橙光类似的互动阅读平台上线，似要掀起一股浪潮。
回忆当年，作者哈里还记得当时充满朝气的氛围，“几乎我们所有人都觉得，橙光未来肯定是能上市的。”看起来，光明的前景正在前方等待。
然而，2018年亿元融资之后，橙光再没有公开可查的融资信息，也在此后慢慢淡出了大众视野。
自2013年橙光游戏平台上线，十几年过去了。这些年间，作者、玩家还有周围的世界都变了太多，而橙光平台又怎样了呢？
“轻短篇、革新派、勤耕奖……”作者小橘口中冒出一连串名词，这些都是橙光作者福利的具体类目。2016年刚签约橙光时，这些作者福利占据她收入的大头。近些年，福利削减之后，依靠着人气积累带来的玩家付费分成，她的总体收益才与之前持平。
查询橙光平台官网公布的福利计划可以发现，2018年，橙光提供的作者奖金总额为1800万元。到2026年，这个数字变成了650万元，仅为此前的三分之一。同时，大多作者福利多与作品付费指标挂钩，集中向营收能力强的作品与作者。
逐条点开网站左侧的福利类目，可以看到更多细节。“过审奖”为每部过审作品提供10个“橙子”，“橙子”可以用于兑换站内道具。“素材补贴券”按类目规则发放总价值200万元的素材券，可用于在站内素材库兑换素材。目前无法确定这200万元是否计算在650万元的奖励总额中。
“新手保护奖”最高600元。“完结奖”按作品字数、鲜花数等指标分别分发，单部作品最高累计千元左右。“天道酬勤奖”则按月更新字数和月鲜花数分档，最高一档3000元。
还有“小金狗储蓄”，这项奖金提升根据满足条件作品的分成比例存储，在作品完结后领取，完结后将不再累计。此外，橙光每年的重要赛事The Best征稿大赛也被列入作者福利计划。
小橘告诉触乐，2018年左右，橙光平台福利设置了“革新派扶持计划”和“轻短篇创新计划”，鼓励创新题材作品。“现在这些都没有了，大家基本都在一个套路里面，哪个题材火就做哪个。橙光也没有特意去推一些小众的作品，而是有点市场化的意思，让作者跟玩家去走比较热门稳妥的路线。”
大约十年前，橙光的平台的作品百花齐放。那时橙光以女性向游戏为主，但也有《潜伏之赤途》《恒水中学连环虐杀》《篱笆庄秘闻》之类题材鲜明丰富的作品，它们也都在当时取得了不错的关注度。
“以前可能有一些作品比较粗糙，但题材确实丰富，有很多创新的作品。”回忆这些年来橙光的变化，小橘说，“现在基本同质化了。像什么宫斗娱乐圈、什么养成，基本都是一样。大家在比谁的养成衣柜比较多，谁的画面比较精美。”
但在橙光全职作者小A看来，这是橙光游戏在商业化上逐渐成熟的标志。在此之前，高人气的作品并不一定能获得高收益，此后作品的人气和收益才匹配起来。小橘也告诉触乐，“那一些百花齐放的作品并没有赚到什么钱。”
在平台商业化发展的过程中，作品的题材取向逐渐清晰和明确起来，作者们用力的方向也发生了变化。
2014年，还在上大学的哈里制作了自己的第一款橙光游戏。当时他为这款游戏付出的成本只有自己的时间。2022年，同样在上大学的小舟却发现，自己一直在贴钱制作游戏。
2014年，橙光游戏画面普遍比较粗糙。哈里的游戏完全依靠橙光免费素材库制作，画面与平台上其他作品差距不大。但他依靠“黑科技”在玩法上做出了差异性。凭借丰富的养成系统和独特的随机机制，这款游戏获得了一定热度，最高登上光影区榜单第四位。
现在，打开橙光制作工具的下载界面，你依然能够看到免费素材库作为宣传亮点，素材的种类包含立绘、音乐、特效等六大门类。但是对于小舟来说，在2022年飞速发展发展的当下，免费的素材往往不具备竞争力。她告诉触乐，“现在平台上的作品玩法差异不大，作者都在卷画面、卷立绘。”
提升画面品质最直接的办法就是向画师约稿。小橘介绍，橙光作者的约稿方式主要有两种：一种是单独和画师约稿，一种则是多个作者集体购买画师授权。前者一张立绘的价格一般几千元左右；后者一张立绘拆分卖给多人，平均每人支付的金额可降至几十元。
出于成本考虑，小橘一般和其他作者组团购买画师授权。一部作品的素材成本大约两三千元左右。小舟的情况大抵相同，不过她作为新人作者人气有限，很难收回这部分成本。
“目前橙光上的作品，基本都是购买授权。玩家看到免费素材，会认为作者对自己的作品不用心。”小舟告诉触乐，“为了作品被更多人看见，我也只能购买授权。”她还透露身边有作者，一部作品的素材成本就达到上万元，最终也没能收回成本。
“我身边大家都是这样，入不敷出地为爱发电。”小舟说。
2017年开始，多家公司先后入局互动阅读平台。其中比较代表性的包括“闪艺”、网易的“易次元”和腾讯的“一零零一”。资本涌入，残酷的竞争随之而来。各家纷纷推出激励计划，而橙光不巧处在一个尴尬的阶段。小A记得，那时的橙光正处在合约争议中。
在那段时间，橙光正频频售出知名作品的改编版权。橙光在同期调整了与作者的合同，将著作权收归平台所有，作者仅拥有署名权。这一改动引发了作者群体不满。而其他平台打出著作权归作者所有的口号，从橙光挖走了一部分作者。等到橙光再次修改合同，把著作权放回作者手中，却为时已晚。
同样是2017年，更大的冲击来自于互动阅读赛道之外，同样面向女性玩家的乙女游戏发展了起来——《恋与制作人》的诞生是一个鲜明节点。相比橙光游戏，重资本、工业化制作乙女游戏美术表现更精致，游戏玩法更丰富，剧情写作也更工整。小舟认为，“乙游出现之后，橙光游戏也越来越强调代入感，但还是不如乙游。”
女性向游戏的浪潮自那时起转向乙女游戏。相比之下，橙光这边平静许多。“偶尔有一两个出圈的作品，但也没有利及其他作品。”小橘说。
上个月，哈里来到北京一所大学讲了一节游戏设计课。课前互动环节，他询问现场的学生有没有玩过橙光游戏。这门课面向数媒专业，现场女生占比很高。
在哈里的预期里，这群女生应该有很多在初中时期接触过橙光游戏的玩家，然而他在现场收到的回应却很少。根据现场的氛围，他推测，有些学生可能并不愿承认自己玩过橙光游戏。
“橙光用户长大之后，平台上的游戏对她们就没有吸引力了。”哈里分析，“随着人生阅历逐渐丰富，橙光游戏的内容深度已经不能满足她们的需求。她们会逐渐离开橙光，选择更有深度的娱乐内容。”
“平台上明显换了一批玩家。”小橘观察到，橙光的玩家一直都是学生群体，留下的老读者很少。现在的这批玩家给她带来了一些困扰，她的作品曾遭到玩家避雷，这是以前罕见的情况，现在却对很多作者来说习以为常——“每个作者都遭到过避雷。如果你没被避雷过的话，那大概率要么你是神，要么你很凉，没有人知道你。”
她认为这一代玩家更有自我意识，也更擅长表达。小橘发现，新发布作品的评论区，经常有玩家问是否可以代入。类似乙女游戏，橙光游戏平台也存在“女主党”和“代入党”的分歧，玩家和作者都被卷入其中。
“如果作者的一部作品标了‘纯代’，评论区就不能出现‘女主’这个词。反过来也是一样。”小橘说，看到有作者被要求退款和切割，她也会感到害怕。
小A也注意到橙光平台上出现了“乙代梦”的话题。“橙光的玩家一直都是年轻人，不同时代的年轻人，”小A说，“大环境在变，女性向游戏都在吵这个，波及到了橙光。”提及十几年前大学时代的作品，小A表示，“都是黑历史。被考古到的话，容易身败名裂。”但他也逐渐放平心态，“其他游戏圈子也在变，橙光并不是独特的。“
2026年6月，互动影游《女王的游戏：盛世天下》女帝篇发售，引发了社交媒体热潮。其官方数据显示，截至2026年9月，“盛世天下”系列累计销量超600万份，创互动影视作品全球销量记录。该系列以精致的影视级视听效果著称，玩家很难想到，它改编自同名橙光游戏。
橙光制作工具的出现，降低了游戏制作的门槛。以自身为平台，橙光汇聚起大量的UGC内容，形成了互动文字游戏的浪潮。橙光因UGC起家，也因UGC衰落。工业化的游戏行业产出了大量高品质的产品，UGC内容难以与之抗衡，处处透出古早味的橙光游戏落在了后面。
互动影游领域则更显尴尬。无论是《盛世天下》还是更早就爆火的《隐形守护者》，都改编自橙光游戏。可橙光自己在互动影游领域的尝试却没有激起太多水花。作品走得更远，孕育它们的平台落在了后面。
现在，AI改变游戏的时代已经到来。橙光在2026年初推出了自己的AI工具——橙戏Agent，定位AI互动影游创作引擎。目前已有多部橙戏制作的作品上线橙光平台。

members.title: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember

ai.body:
10th November 2026 - Link Blog
Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember. Meta AI just launched their entry in the Claude Haiku/GPT Luna category: Muse Ember, which they describe as:
[...] our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing.
For shorter prompts it's priced the same as GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 - both are $0.10/million input tokens and $0.50/million output. Today's other big model release, Claude Fable 5.2, is 80x that price at $8/$40.
The pricing is a little less straightforward as prompts get longer, though. Luna, Ember, and Haiku all support up to a million input tokens, but they also all have a threshold after which the price goes up. Taking that threshold into account Ember is priced between the two others:
| Model | Prompt size | Input ($/M) | Cached input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GPT-6 Luna | ≤272k | $0.10 | $0.01 | $0.50 |
| >272k | $0.20 | $0.02 | $0.75 | |
| Muse Ember 1.0 | ≤200k | $0.10 | $0.004 | $0.50 |
| >200k | $0.30 | $0.012 | $1.50 | |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 | ≤100k | $0.10 | $0.01 | $0.50 |
| >100k | $0.50 | $0.05 | $2.50 |
But comparing price-per-token doesn't really make sense these days, when reasoning tokens mean that different models might use dramatically different numbers of tokens to solve the same problem.
For that, one measure that's useful is the Artificial Analysis.
And even more useful than that is their Intelligence Index vs. Cost per Task chart, which shows the following for those three models:
The Muse Ember models sit right on that Pareto line - the line at which you can only improve one dimension by giving up another. Meta call this out in their announcement:
It also sits on the efficiency frontier of the full Artificial Analysis leaderboard: no model scores higher for less per task.
(That grey dot on the Pareto line in the middle of the green area is GPT-6.1 Terra (low) - clearly I should be paying more attention to the Terra family!)
Muse Ember has six reasoning levels - minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, and max - so I rendered six pelicans riding bicycles. The "high" reasoning level failed to return a full SVG, and the other SVGs were surprising in that the reasoning level didn't cleanly map to the visual quality of the response.
Here's the "max" one, but the others are worth a look too:
The Ember pelicans are comparable in quality to those I got from Muse Wonder, which is 40x the price of Muse Ember.

Claude Fable 5.2 responds closely to what the prompt says about who owns the code it works on. In Anthropic’s testing on small coding tasks, when a prompt said nothing about ownership or presented the code base as someone else’s, the model tended to add to the existing structure, even when that repeated existing code. [...]
If you want the model to improve the structure as it works, say that the code is its own:
This codebase is yours: what it's for and how it's built are your call, and you'll keep building on it.
In Anthropic’s testing on small coding tasks, the model merged repeated code in about half of the tries with this sentence, and in under a tenth of the tries without it.
— Prompting Claude Fable 5.2, Anthropic documentation

members.title: 腾讯混元跻身最强开源模型！一手实测Hy4：搭配WorkBuddy，多模态Agent交付力拉满

ai.body:
腾讯混元跻身最强开源模型！一手实测Hy4：搭配WorkBuddy，多模态Agent交付力拉满
闻乐 发自 凹非寺
量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI
混元Hy4正式交卷了！
腾讯这次上来根本不跟你客气，态度就明晃晃写在脸上：跻身最强开源模型之列。
770B总参数、49B激活参数，首次引入原生视觉能力、首次支持电脑操作。
指令遵循、长文理解和长程Agent能力也一起升级，电脑操作、长程Agent任务都挤进了开源阵营前排。
从preview到正式版，Hy4显著扩展了预训练和后训练的数据与训练规模，甚至还直接跑去跟一线业务搞起了“Co-Design”联合打磨。
WorkBuddy国内版、国际版已经同步完成首发接入！
我就先在WorkBuddy里给它出了个难题：给我搓一把完全可交互的3D机械键盘出来。
75%配列、84键，键帽、轴体、定位板、PCB、电池和外壳，六层结构都安排上了。
鼠标拽着能原地炸开看内部做工，装回去还能直接上手敲，连按键下压、弹簧受力回弹的物理动效都给你算进去了。
这么一看，制作新品展示demo的活儿不就有人干了？你说是吧Hy4～
Hy4已经在腾讯云TokenHub、WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy、元宝、企业微信智能助理大圆、ima等产品上线；API同步接入OpenRouter、Hermes、OpenCode等平台。
QQ、王者荣耀、和平精英、微信读书、腾讯新闻等腾讯系产品也在持续接入中。
模型权重也将于近期开源。
那咱也话不多说，先来实测一波。
像素级视觉感知
Hy4首次引入的视觉理解，细节识别已经精细到能够在28亿像素航拍图中，定位约2米的屋顶构件。
这眼神儿是真不错。
那咱接下来也考考它的眼力。
第一道题，照着一张设计截图，做一个复古风格的音乐播放器。
先不说高清航拍图，我就想看看，它到底能不能看懂排版细节。
Hy4接单之后先把图里的配色、字体、布局挨个拆了一遍，连左侧栏宽多少像素都量好了，然后才开始写代码，把页面和播放功能一起搭起来。
中间裁切工具出了点偏差，它还换了个办法，直接分析像素来定位线条、提取颜色。
行，做题还自带尺子和色卡。
看到成品的那一刻，我盯着屏幕看了足足半分钟，不er，这还原度得99.9%吧——
米色打底、橙红点缀、黄绿配色，再加上粗粗的大标题和一张黑胶唱片，复古味儿一下就上来了。
导航、歌单、播放区域和待播列表，也都待在该待的位置。
我把买家秀和卖家秀并排放着找了半天不同，最显眼的居然是左上角那俩前进后退按钮：一个圆，一个方。。。
属于是不拿放大镜看，都不知道该从哪儿挑刺。
翻了翻Hy4的交付说明，播放暂停、上下首切换、拖动进度、调节音量都接上了，循环、随机播放、搜索和收藏同步也没落下。
连手懒得碰鼠标的情况都考虑到了：空格控制播放，方向键调整进度。
然而当我点下播放键才发现，它连三首测试曲子都给备好了。
我没给它传任何音频文件啊！
原来这些曲子是它用浏览器原生的Web Audio实时合成的，不用我再满电脑翻音频文件，打开网页就能听。
好好好，我只给了一张图，Hy4不仅交付了播放器，还附赠测试曲库，顺手把试音的活儿也包了。
接着翻它的自测流水。
照记录里的过程，Hy4写完代码后，自己悄悄在后台拉起了一个无头Chrome浏览器，在沙盒环境里对着各个UI按钮挨个点击、拖拽，一边点一边截图做视觉差异对比。
第一轮其实也没一把全过：
51项过了48项，两项卡在测试脚本，最后一项被它自己揪出来——列表放完最后一首歌，再点下一首时逻辑没处理闭环。
它反手把这个边缘Case改了，重新跑回归。
最终报告显示，59项测试全部通过，控制台报错和运行时异常均为零。
光二维界面还不够过瘾，我又扔给Hy4一张游乐场平面图，让它把园子给“立”起来。
设施在哪儿、多大，路怎么拐弯，都得照着图来；摩天轮和旋转木马也不能光站着摆造型，得转起来；这游乐园还得能让我进去逛。
经历了一连串几何体建模、着色器配置和摄像机绑定，它真的把整座“星光游乐园”原地拔地而起了。
经典的红白旋转木马顶棚、主路两旁的小卖部、沿街分布的低多边形树木与草皮，全按比例投射进了三维空间。
低多边形画风也挺清爽，看着像个适合摸鱼时进去溜达两圈的小游戏。
我本来都做好了进门先迷路的准备，右上角居然还配了张小地图：设施、道路、草坪，连我现在站哪儿都标出来了。
进园后，WASD移动，鼠标拖动转向，按住Shift还能加速，想看设施就打开标签。
逛晕了还能一键返回入口，主打一个随时找得着北。
它甚至准备了“沿道路自动巡游”的按钮，点一下，连路都不用自己走。
好嘛，让它建个游乐园，导览服务也一起开张了。
Agent交付力拉满
游乐园逛完，回来干点正事，试试Hy4这次重点强化的Agent和长程任务能力。
我给它塞了一份“拾光Beam Go 2”便携智能投影仪的产品资料，让它做套15页左右的新品介绍PPT。
Hy4先把资料从头捋了一遍，配图也没瞎找，直接利用原生代码绘制风格高度统一的矢量示意图，图表则保留成可编辑的形式，方便后续修改。
在渲染第4页时，它发现一段长文本挤出了页面安全边框，自己在后台立刻重构版式，把单栏拆成了卡片流，二次校验通过后才继续往下推进。
最后一共交了16页PPT。行，还多送一页。
不过，打工人都懂，PPT做完了，往往才是改PPT的开始。
我又扔给它一份完全不同视觉体系的暗黑高对比度模板，要求它按新版式重刷一遍。
Hy4倒没急着把16页全改了，先挑一页试着套进去，确认没问题，再批量修改剩下的页面。
不得不说，边验证边工作的能力是它这次非常亮眼的优势，不是一股脑输出完就交差，而是小步试错、验证通过再推进，大幅减少返工。
接着，我又给Hy4派了个活儿：
做一个高可用性的图片批量处理工具。
裁切、改尺寸、压缩、导出，单张图折腾几下还行，一批图挨个来，鼠标没坏，人先麻了。
这次干脆把重复的手工操作交给它。
Hy4领到任务后，先在环境里去研读了业内开源标杆Squoosh和Image Workspace的优秀设计，借鉴了原图/压缩图对比滑杆、预设工作流的技术方案。
然后快速拆分出上传流、处理流、Web Worker多线程并行、Canvas图形管线、ZIP归档模块，直接敲代码。
成品交付的时候，名字都起好了——
ATELIER影像批处理工作台。
米白底色、橙色点缀，打开先弹出三步引导。Slogan是：“把重复的交给工具，把审美留给自己。”
行，我负责审美，它负责重复。
按交付设计，图片可以整批拖入，也能直接选文件夹；左侧统一设置裁切、尺寸、压缩和格式，少数需要“特殊照顾”的图片，再单独调整。
它还顺手内置了社交头像1:1、电商主图、极小体积等常用配方，拉动滑杆能实时看画质损失，最后点击一次打包成ZIP扔给浏览器下载。
除此之外，Hy4现在还真能拿起鼠标干活。
打开Chrome里的JS Paint，用鼠标临摹混元亲亲表情包，还得把操作过程录下来。
看屏幕、找工具、选颜色，再控制鼠标落笔，用上的正是它新支持的CUA（计算机使用）能力。
好嘛，别的AI忙着一键出图，Hy4在这儿练鼠绘，上有参考图负责考眼力，下有画图软件负责考手艺（doge）。
加量不加价
实测玩这么一圈，我最大的感受是，Hy4在长程任务中的自主执行完成度高了很多。
面对多步骤任务，它能够持续保持目标与任务状态，在执行过程中进行阶段性自检，根据运行结果定位问题、修改方案，再重新验证，直到能交付无Bug的结果。
我前面的案例确实也都是它自主执行、检查和修改后的一次性交付结果。
Hy4的这轮训练也更追求在真实生产力场景发挥作用。
前端优化细化到了复杂交互、业务逻辑、状态管理及前后端联动；
对Blender、CAD等专业软件和跨应用长程任务也进行了专项训练，强化任务规划与执行能力。
办公场景下，Hy4还围绕时效检索、多源信息整合和事实一致性校验，对搜索链路进行了专项优化。
在内部测试中，Hy4的幻觉率由preview版的12.95%降至7.2%，推测类错误率由23.1%降至5.6%；
金融这边，Hy4还专门补了一轮专业课。
训练覆盖基金研究、证券分析、量化策略、资产配置、公司金融和财税会计等方向，基于真实场景构建了数千个工作空间、上万个高质量任务，让模型学习专业流程与规范。
共有213位专家参与众测，其中七成来自外部头部金融机构，拥有五年以上工作经验——
这批阅卷人，可没那么好糊弄。
结果579个真实金融任务测下来，Hy4综合表现位居开源模型第一。
看来这轮“进修”，还真没白上。
科研任务的跨度也正在扩大。
Hy4将复杂推理、科学编程与长程执行结合，在涵盖7大学科、123项可执行研究任务的TenureTrail内部评测中，展现了数学构造、物理建模等领域的科研能力。
面对包含699万个单细胞、整整84张没有任何时间空间连续标记的二维无序小鼠胚胎切片的数据集还混杂着实验切片中常见的镜像翻转等噪声数据；在离线运行、无专用配准工具、无细胞类型标注的严苛条件下，Hy4耗时1.5小时，自主完成小鼠胚胎切片的空间对齐与三维网格重构。
全程零人工干预，最终对齐精细度甚至干掉了专业配准工具的默认配置流程。
它也开始把复杂推理、科学编程和长程执行串起来。
在与北京大学数学团队合作的研究中，Hy4找到了Méndez–Pinto–Villarreal猜想的反例，进一步提出新条件完善猜想，并对相关证明进行Lean形式化验证。
这些能力现在已经可以通过WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy体验。即日起至11月15日23:59还有限时免费体验！
朋友们要是手上还有什么搁了很久、总嫌麻烦的活儿，可以趁这会儿给Hy4安排一下~
最后再提醒一波，主打极低推理成本、适合端侧与高并发Agent编排的Hy4 flash也已经在路上了。

千问办公2.0发布，首个支持多人与Agent协作的Team Agent来了
11月9日，千问办公发布2.0版本
11月9日，千问办公发布2.0版本，这是其上线三个月以来最大的一次升级。该版本推出了行业首个支持多人与Agent协作的功能“协作”，同时上线“人机共创”、“资料空间”、“自动任务”和“三端互联”等核心能力，让Agent从服务个人走向服务团队和组织。目前，所有功能已在千问办公客户端全量上线。
千问办公在同日发布的官方博客《千问办公2.0：主动与协同，迈向Team Agent时代》中指出，主流办公Agent的产品形态仍以服务个人为主，团队的协作方式并未发生变化，下一代Agent需要进入团队协作的现场。
千问办公推出的“协作”功能率先把Agent带进工作群，用户可以组建一个团队和数字员工共同工作的协作空间。真实的工作通常发生在办公软件的群里，一个复杂项目的信息可能会分散在多个群聊和会议纪要中，成员只能手动搬运、汇总信息。现在，数字员工在协作空间内能实时关联多个钉钉群聊、文档、AI表格和AI听记等信息源，支持多个会话并行，以及任务管理与指派。成员在协作空间内指派任务，数字员工就能结合空间的上下文，梳理进展、总结共识、创建并跟进待办。
据介绍，银泰百货卡券运营团队基于该功能大幅提升了团队工作效率。过去，该团队5名运营人员要在60多个门店群里逐一收集卡券提报信息，核对后再回填到表格。现在，团队把这些门店群和一张AI表格关联到同一个协作空间，原有的沟通方式不变，Agent可跨群汇总信息并自动更新表格，显著减少了运营团队的工作量。
千问办公上线的 “自动任务”功能，首次让Agent从被动响应，升级为主动帮用户干活。千问办公官方博客指出，下一代企业级Agent需要具备感知业务、主动推进的能力，而不是等人启动。基于“自动任务”功能，用户可以订阅事件、配置规则，条件满足时Agent自动开始处理。目前，该功能首批支持指定人的消息、指定群内@自己的消息、审批任务等触发场景。
以线下门店管理场景为例，区域经理要同时关注多家门店，不同门店的缺货反馈很容易被大量群消息淹没。现在，区域经理使用“自动任务”设定触发条件“群里有人@我说缺货，就读取库存表，发起调货申请”后，只要有店员发送缺货相关信息，千问办公便可结合群聊上下文读取库存，并自动将调货信息填入表格里，区域经理无需一直盯群。
千问办公还推出了“人机共创”能力，实现对话、内容预览与产物编辑的打通。用户基于该能力，无需跨软件查阅、修订，即可在对话框内边看文档预览边提修改要求，也可以直接选中段落、单元格、幻灯片或应用区域，标记多处意见后一次提交，AI根据修改意见在原文档中直接修改。针对在线文档、AI表格、宜搭应用，该功能还可支持多人、多Agent在线同时共创。
新上线的“资料空间”则可收录AI生成和用户上传的图片、文档、表格、PPT、网页、应用和本地文件，并支持查看、搜索、分享等操作，选中单一或多份文件还能直接发起新对话，或通过“人机共创”继续修改。例如，用户选中多份行业调研材料，可直接生成一份市场规划方案。
此外，千问办公2.0还进一步拓展了用户的使用场景，支持手机、电脑、网页三端实时同步任务、对话和产物，任务在云端执行，电脑关机后任务照常运行。用户授权后，离开工位也能通过手机远程操作电脑。
作为业界首个企业级Agent，千问办公此前已初步打通钉钉、飞书、企业微信等IM软件。随着IM软件、原生Office和SaaS软件的原子能力集成到Agent客户端，千问办公已向企业级Team Agent演进，引领了人机协作的新范式。
